description: List workspace-scoped provider instances and their limits or status. Use this to find provider slugs for workspace-level updates; use list_integrations for the org-level source connection. Returns total plus provider name, slug, integration, status, limits, expiration, and reset flags.

current_page.description: Zero-based page number; the first page is 0

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 100, default 50)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID - required when using organization admin keys, optional with workspace API keys

name: list_providers

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
